verdict.rationale: All evidence describes monday.com exposing its own hosted/developer MCP server for external agents (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to connect to monday's tools, i.e. monday acting as an MCP server/provider — not the reverse of monday's AI agents consuming external MCP servers' tools as a client. No documentation shows a user plugging a third-party MCP server into monday so its agents can call those tools. Missing for 10: any evidence of monday supporting inbound MCP server connections/tool consumption, docs on adding external MCP endpoints as agent tool sources, and independent confirmation of such a feature.
